pump_package_coverage: WITH admitted AS (SELECT DISTINCT bronze_record_sha256,collection_source_id FROM silver) SELECT b.collection_role,COUNT(*) AS all_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.pump_program_involvement IS TRUE) AS pump_referencing_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.pump_program_involvement IS TRUE AND b.transaction_status='ERROR') AS failed_pump_referencing_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.bronze_record_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AS packages_with_admitted_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.pump_program_involvement IS TRUE AND a.bronze_record_sha256 IS NULL) AS pump_referencing_without_admitted_fact,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.pump_program_involvement IS NULL) AS unknown_pump_involvement FROM bronze b LEFT JOIN admitted a ON a.bronze_record_sha256=b.record_sha256 AND a.collection_source_id=b.collection_source_id GROUP BY b.collection_role ORDER BY b.collection_role
role_coverage: SELECT collection_source_id,collection_role,slice_class,disposition,transaction_status,COUNT(DISTINCT slot) AS slots_with_outcome,COUNT(*) AS packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS TRUE) AS pump_referencing_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS NULL) AS pump_involvement_unknown,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_metadata_bytes IS NULL) AS missing_status_metadata FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
role_trade_coverage: SELECT collection_role,is_buy,candidate_id,transaction_status,COUNT(*) AS admitted_observations,COUNT(DISTINCT mint) AS mints,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_base_decimals,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_quote_decimals FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
pilot_mint_recurrence: WITH pilot AS (SELECT DISTINCT mint FROM silver WHERE collection_role='ORIGINAL_SELECTION'), context_trades AS (SELECT mint,COUNT(*) AS trades,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy) AS buys,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_buy) AS sells,MIN(slot) AS first_trade_slot,MAX(slot) AS last_trade_slot FROM silver WHERE collection_role='POSTHOC_DESCRIPTIVE_CONTEXT' GROUP BY mint), context_balances AS (SELECT o.mint,COUNT(*) AS observations,COUNT(DISTINCT (b.slot,b.transaction_index)) AS packages FROM bronze b,UNNEST(b.token_balance_observations) t(o) WHERE b.collection_role='POSTHOC_DESCRIPTIVE_CONTEXT' AND o.mint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.mint) SELECT p.mint,COALESCE(t.trades,0) AS context_admitted_trades,COALESCE(t.buys,0) AS context_admitted_buys,COALESCE(t.sells,0) AS context_admitted_sells,COALESCE(b.observations,0) AS context_recorded_balance_observations,COALESCE(b.packages,0) AS context_balance_packages,t.first_trade_slot,t.last_trade_slot,'Zero means no row in these projected channels, not zero market activity' AS coverage_limit FROM pilot p LEFT JOIN context_trades t USING(mint) LEFT JOIN context_balances b USING(mint) ORDER BY p.mint
mint_admitted_sides: SELECT mint,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy) AS buys,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_buy) AS sells,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy)>0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_buy)>0 AS has_both_admitted_sides,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE collection_role='ORIGINAL_SELECTION') AS pilot_trades,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE collection_role='POSTHOC_DESCRIPTIVE_CONTEXT') AS posthoc_trades,COUNT(DISTINCT user_address) AS observed_users,COUNT(DISTINCT units_decimals) AS observed_base_decimal_scales,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_base_units,MIN(slot) AS first_observed_trade_slot,MAX(slot) AS last_observed_trade_slot,'No automatic same-trader round-trip, fill or return' AS interpretation FROM silver GROUP BY mint ORDER BY mint
mint_trade_sequence: SELECT mint,collection_role,slot,transaction_index,outer_index,instruction_inner_order,instruction_stack_height,event_inner_order,event_stack_height,event_association,user_address,is_buy,event_instruction_name,token_amount_raw_u64,sol_amount_raw_u64,quote_amount_raw_u64,spendable_quote_in_raw_u64,min_tokens_out_raw_u64,amount_raw_u64,min_sol_output_raw_u64,units_decimals,units_decimals_evidence,units_event_token_amount_decimal,units_base_token_program,timestamp_raw_i64 AS event_reported_timestamp,quote_mint_identity,quote_decimals,transaction_status,cpi_signer,cpi_writable,first_signature,raw_sha256,bronze_record_sha256,record_sha256 FROM silver ORDER BY mint,slot,transaction_index,outer_index,instruction_inner_order NULLS FIRST,event_inner_order,record_ordinal
mint_units_and_time_gaps: SELECT mint,collection_role,COUNT(*) AS admitted_trade_observations,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_base_decimals,COUNT(DISTINCT units_decimals) AS distinct_base_decimal_scales,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote_decimals IS NULL) AS unknown_quote_decimals,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE timestamp_raw_i64 IS NULL) AS missing_event_reported_time,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE observed_at_state<>'VALUE') AS unavailable_observation_model_time,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE execution_opportunity_at_state<>'VALUE') AS unavailable_execution_time,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE name_state<>'VALUE') AS unknown_names,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticker_state<>'VALUE') AS unknown_tickers,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE launch_at_state<>'VALUE') AS unknown_launch_dates FROM silver GROUP BY mint,collection_role ORDER BY mint,collection_role
